variants.parameter_guidance: Capture an Animation Blueprint editor viewport or graph. Opening defaults false; graph or window changes require explicit mutation flags. This captures editor UI, not a PIE animation test.

asset_path.description: Optional asset path; normally derived from subject_ref.

capture_height.description: Optional graph draw height; when graph size is requested the native default is 900 pixels.

capture_width.description: Optional graph draw width; when graph size is requested the native default is 1440 pixels.

target.description: viewport, components, eventgraph/event_graph, graph, graph:<name>, or window.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the returned operation, inspect its native result and materialize the image artifacts, then release. Read reported capture scope and any native editor changes.
variants.summary: Capture an Animation Blueprint editor viewport or graph. Opening defaults false; graph or window changes require explicit mutation flags. This captures editor UI, not a PIE animation test.

variants.parameter_guidance: Read a content folder's registry and native cached thumbnails into named contact sheets; no asset editors or implicit asset loading.

variants.summary: Read a content folder's registry and native cached thumbnails into named contact sheets; no asset editors or implicit asset loading.

variants.summary: Capture the requested asset's real preview using its applied HJSON preview configuration. Select single or sequence and an optional target from preview/index.hjson; configure size and sampling in that target's capture.hjson.

graph_name_or_path.description: Alias used when graph_name is omitted.

variants.parameter_guidance: Evaluate a Level Sequence at explicit frames/time objects or count/start/interval samples; default is display frame zero. This is an independent final-color scene render with camera post-processing, not a viewport backbuffer screenshot. Viewport fallback borrows camera geometry, not editor rendering state or exposure history. Multiple frames require sheet or individual output.

asset_path.description: Optional asset path; normally derived from subject_ref.

create_frame_sheet.description: Defaults true for multiple frames. At least sheet or individual output must remain enabled.

frames.description: Explicit display-frame numbers or time/frame objects; overrides count/start/interval. Time uses the sequence display rate.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the returned operation, inspect its native result and materialize the image artifacts, then release. Read reported capture scope and any native editor changes.
variants.summary: Evaluate a Level Sequence at explicit frames/time objects or count/start/interval samples; default is display frame zero. This is an independent final-color scene render with camera post-processing, not a viewport backbuffer screenshot. Viewport fallback borrows camera geometry, not editor rendering state or exposure history. Multiple frames require sheet or individual output.

asset_path.description: Optional asset path; normally derived from subject_ref.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the returned operation, inspect its native result and materialize the image artifacts, then release. Read reported capture scope and any native editor changes.
variants.summary: Capture the native graph editor for a MetaSound Source or Patch; this is a graph image, not rendered audio.

variants.parameter_guidance: Capture the active level viewport, optionally framing an exact actor first. Use an actor subject for framing or capture-subject:viewport:active to retain the current framing. Camera position/rotation changes remain applied; restore the previous viewport explicitly when needed. This captures visible PCG output and does not generate a PCG graph.

actor.description: Optional framing selector; normally derived from the actor subject. Prefer the exact subject_ref.

actor_label.description: Framing alias used when actor and actor_name are empty or absent.

actor_name.description: Framing alias used when actor is empty or absent.

fallback_offsets_cm.description: Explicit world-space alternate-view offsets in centimeters. Each vector has three finite components; zero offsets are ignored.

fallback_step_cm.description: Automatic alternate-view step in centimeters; negative values are clamped to zero.

id.description: Optional framing identity; it must identify the same actor as the subject and other framing selectors.

padding.description: Multiplier applied to the actor bounds for framing.

safety_offset_cm.description: Collision clearance in centimeters; negative values are clamped to zero.

trace_channel.description: Case-insensitive visibility, camera, worldstatic/world_static, worlddynamic/world_dynamic, pawn or physicsbody/physics_body; the corresponding ecc_ names are accepted.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the operation, inspect frame_actor and screenshot details and materialize the image artifact, then release. Realtime and temporary view mode follow the viewport capture restoration settings; actor framing does not restore the camera transform.
variants.summary: Capture the active level viewport, optionally framing an exact actor first. Use an actor subject for framing or capture-subject:viewport:active to retain the current framing. Camera position/rotation changes remain applied; restore the previous viewport explicitly when needed. This captures visible PCG output and does not generate a PCG graph.

variants.parameter_guidance: Capture a Sound Cue graph editor widget. The native result also reports node count; no audio playback is implied.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the returned operation, inspect its native result and materialize the image artifacts, then release. Read reported capture scope and any native editor changes.
variants.summary: Capture a Sound Cue graph editor widget. The native result also reports node count; no audio playback is implied.

asset_path.description: Optional asset path; normally derived from subject_ref.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the returned operation, inspect its native result and materialize the image artifacts, then release. Read reported capture scope and any native editor changes.
variants.summary: Capture the native StateTree editor widget. The editor may open if needed; this does not execute the state machine.

variants.parameter_guidance: Read a texture source image at the requested mip, slice and face. Source pixels must be available; max_size optionally resizes the output. No asset editor window is required.

asset_path.description: Optional texture path; normally derived from subject_ref.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the returned operation, inspect its native result and materialize the image artifacts, then release. Read reported capture scope and any native editor changes.
variants.summary: Read a texture source image at the requested mip, slice and face. Source pixels must be available; max_size optionally resizes the output. No asset editor window is required.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use subject_ref capture-subject:actor:<exact Actor object path> and provide 1-15 labeled candidates. The policy captures the original plus each candidate from the current Level Viewport into one frame sheet, restores Actor transform, package dirty state, Actor selection, and viewport realtime state, and does not persist or choose a candidate.
variants.result_guidance: Poll operation.status until terminal. Success publishes one frame-sheet artifact and guarantees the preview state was restored; inspect the sheet, then submit the chosen transform separately and release the operation.
variants.summary: Use subject_ref capture-subject:actor:<exact Actor object path> and provide 1-15 labeled candidates. The policy captures the original plus each candidate from the current Level Viewport into one frame sheet, restores Actor transform, package dirty state, Actor selection, and viewport realtime state, and does not persist or choose a candidate.

variants.parameter_guidance: Capture a WidgetBlueprint in design-time mode. capture_width/capture_height specify canvas pixels; crop_mode=full_canvas preserves that canvas, while region={x,y,width,height} selects a pixel crop. Omit max_size to avoid output resizing. Set use_project_dpi_scale=true for the project viewport DPI rule. This does not run Construct or validate runtime interaction.

asset_path.description: Optional subject alias; must identify the same WidgetBlueprint as subject_ref.

capture_height.description: Offscreen canvas height in pixels, before cropping or output resizing.

capture_width.description: Offscreen canvas width in pixels, before cropping or output resizing.

crop.description: Pixel rectangle in the captured canvas: x/y default to zero; supply width and height. crop_* and left/top/w/h are accepted aliases.

crop_mode.description: full_canvas preserves the requested canvas. auto_bounds crops transparent margins; a supplied region selects manual_region unless another crop mode is explicit.

max_size.description: Optional post-crop output resizing; omit to preserve pixels.

region.description: Pixel rectangle in the captured canvas: x/y default to zero; supply width and height. crop_* and left/top/w/h are accepted aliases.

variants.result_guidance: Resume the operation to terminal, read its receipt and materialize the image artifact. The receipt distinguishes design-time rendering, applied DPI scale, canvas and crop. Release the operation after reading artifacts.
variants.summary: Capture a WidgetBlueprint in design-time mode. capture_width/capture_height specify canvas pixels; crop_mode=full_canvas preserves that canvas, while region={x,y,width,height} selects a pixel crop. Omit max_size to avoid output resizing. Set use_project_dpi_scale=true for the project viewport DPI rule. This does not run Construct or validate runtime interaction.

variants.parameter_guidance: Capture the active level viewport buffer: SceneDepth, DeviceDepth, BaseColor or WorldNormal. The buffer is sampled from the current scene and viewpoint.

buffer.description: SceneDepth, DeviceDepth, BaseColor or WorldNormal; native aliases are also accepted.

variants.result_guidance: Finish the operation and inspect the buffer image artifact before release.
variants.summary: Capture the active level viewport buffer: SceneDepth, DeviceDepth, BaseColor or WorldNormal. The buffer is sampled from the current scene and viewpoint.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use exact subject_ref capture-subject:viewport:active. Captures the requested ordered frames across real Editor engine frames from one active Level Viewport and publishes a frame sheet plus raw frame files.
variants.result_guidance: Poll operation.status until terminal, then inspect frame_sheet_file_path, raw_frames and capture metadata before releasing the operation.
variants.summary: Use exact subject_ref capture-subject:viewport:active. Captures the requested ordered frames across real Editor engine frames from one active Level Viewport and publishes a frame sheet plus raw frame files.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use exact subject_ref capture-subject:viewport:active. Optional parameters select png/jpg/jpeg output, quality, maximum size, output path, warmup frames and a temporary view mode that is restored after capture.

cold_start_render_size.description: Optional explicit extent for a zero-sized Editor viewport. Omission adapts to its window's single-monitor work area, bounded to 4096 per edge; display lookup failure uses primary monitor then 1280x720. Existing positive viewport extents take precedence. No native window geometry changes; max_size remains output downscaling.

variants.result_guidance: Poll operation.status until terminal, read latest_signal.payload.artifact_ref, then verify the published image artifact before releasing the operation.
variants.summary: Use exact subject_ref capture-subject:viewport:active. Optional parameters select png/jpg/jpeg output, quality, maximum size, output path, warmup frames and a temporary view mode that is restored after capture.

variants.parameter_guidance: Managed ownership closes windows created by UAI, including implicit previews and native reload replacements; existing user windows are borrowed. Use ownership=adopt only to explicitly take responsibility for existing windows of this asset.
variants.result_guidance: Wait for active, then cancel and observe actual cleanup. cleanup_pending retains the operation and reports the remaining window; resolve unsaved changes and recover/close again. Shared holders close the window when the final holder releases it.
variants.summary: Managed ownership closes windows created by UAI, including implicit previews and native reload replacements; existing user windows are borrowed. Use ownership=adopt only to explicitly take responsibility for existing windows of this asset.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use the exact asset and a preview action advertised by its preview/index.hjson. Stable configuration is edited in the workspace; seek requires time_seconds. Opens the native asset preview if needed and leaves it open.
variants.result_guidance: Resume to terminal, inspect the native details and release. Release does not close or reset the asset preview. Playback support follows the actual preview owner.
variants.summary: Use the exact asset and a preview action advertised by its preview/index.hjson. Stable configuration is edited in the workspace; seek requires time_seconds. Opens the native asset preview if needed and leaves it open.

variants.parameter_guidance: spawn_transient_box creates an operation-owned dynamic mesh at the world origin. Sizes are centimeters, each in (0, 100000]. This is a transient modeling session, not a saved asset.
variants.result_guidance: Observe the active session and close it to destroy the owned transient actor; release only after cleanup completes.
variants.summary: spawn_transient_box creates an operation-owned dynamic mesh at the world origin. Sizes are centimeters, each in (0, 100000]. This is a transient modeling session, not a saved asset.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use pcg-component:<exact loaded component_path> from a current-world PCG read and empty parameters. Explicitly generates or regenerates unchanged inputs through native PCG, preserving its cache and editor settings. Requires an active, assigned graph outside preview/runtime generation and no current generation, cleanup or refresh.
variants.result_guidance: Finish this finite operation. generation_started and generation_completed refer to this native task, not persisted output. Cancel stops only its owned task and does not roll back partial effects. Successful output remains after release; save the affected map/resources through the existing editor save entry. PCG spatial reads provide independent output inspection.
variants.summary: Use pcg-component:<exact loaded component_path> from a current-world PCG read and empty parameters. Explicitly generates or regenerates unchanged inputs through native PCG, preserving its cache and editor settings. Requires an active, assigned graph outside preview/runtime generation and no current generation, cleanup or refresh.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use a registered culture and matching culture:<name> subject. restore_after=true applies and restores immediately; false keeps the preview active until closed.

culture.description: Registered culture name matching the culture: subject.

variants.result_guidance: Inspect the terminal result for immediate preview, or wait for active and close the retained preview to restore the previous culture.
variants.summary: Use a registered culture and matching culture:<name> subject. restore_after=true applies and restores immediately; false keeps the preview active until closed.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use family_id runtime_preview, one exact runtime-subject:pie:<instance>, this policy_id and optional local_player_index 0. Optional viewport_width/viewport_height are positive physical pixel dimensions, defaulting to 1280/720. They affect only this session, not saved Play window preferences. The operation becomes active only after exact single-PIE/single-player resolution, a verified pause and initial current-workspace publication.

viewport_height.description: PIE viewport height in physical pixels; session-local, independent of desktop DPI and saved Play window preferences.

viewport_width.description: PIE viewport width in physical pixels; session-local, independent of desktop DPI and saved Play window preferences.

variants.result_guidance: Resume until phase active, then use the SDK-owned RuntimeSessionHandle to execute bounded scenarios. Session identity and pause/workspace fences remain machine-side; cancel this editor session only after scenarios are terminal and released.
variants.summary: Use family_id runtime_preview, one exact runtime-subject:pie:<instance>, this policy_id and optional local_player_index 0. Optional viewport_width/viewport_height are positive physical pixel dimensions, defaulting to 1280/720. They affect only this session, not saved Play window preferences. The operation becomes active only after exact single-PIE/single-player resolution, a verified pause and initial current-workspace publication.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use family_id runtime_preview, subject_ref runtime-subject:pie:<non-negative instance>, this policy_id and an empty parameters object.
variants.result_guidance: Resume the returned operation until the PIE session is running; use runtime_instance queries for readback, then cancel, resume to terminal, read the receipt and release.
variants.summary: Use family_id runtime_preview, subject_ref runtime-subject:pie:<non-negative instance>, this policy_id and an empty parameters object.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use an exact world:/Game/... destination package. fail rejects an existing map, reuse activates it, and replace creates and saves a new blank map at that path. save_existing_map defaults true; create_world_partition affects newly created maps.
variants.result_guidance: Finish the operation and inspect its receipt, then read the current world and dirty resources. The saved map remains after release; reuse does not recreate it.
variants.summary: Use an exact world:/Game/... destination package. fail rejects an existing map, reuse activates it, and replace creates and saves a new blank map at that path. save_existing_map defaults true; create_world_partition affects newly created maps.

variants.parameter_guidance: Use the current partitioned world and an existing DataLayerAsset instance. Supply loaded_in_editor and/or visible. This temporary session does not change initial runtime state or saved user loading preferences.
variants.result_guidance: Wait for active, inspect Data Layer flags and Actor descriptors, then close to restore both original Editor flags and refresh loaders. Close before switching maps or editing the same layer elsewhere.
variants.summary: Use the current partitioned world and an existing DataLayerAsset instance. Supply loaded_in_editor and/or visible. This temporary session does not change initial runtime state or saved user loading preferences.

variants.parameter_guidance: The subject must be the current Editor World with World Partition. Supply at least one discovered actor GUID or current-world actor identity; both arrays may be combined. dry_run validates without loading.

actor_guids.description: Actor GUIDs returned by World Partition discovery.

actor_ids.description: Exact path, name or label of actors in the current world; prefer an unambiguous path.

variants.result_guidance: Observe the operation-owned loader until active, then close to unload/drain it. Dry-run success does not mean actors were loaded.
variants.summary: The subject must be the current Editor World with World Partition. Supply at least one discovered actor GUID or current-world actor identity; both arrays may be combined. dry_run validates without loading.

variants.parameter_guidance: The subject must be the current Editor World with World Partition. Supply world-space center and nonnegative half-extents in centimeters. dry_run validates without retaining a loader.
variants.result_guidance: A real loader remains active and owned by the operation. Close it to unload/drain; a dry run terminates with a planned result.
variants.summary: The subject must be the current Editor World with World Partition. Supply world-space center and nonnegative half-extents in centimeters. dry_run validates without retaining a loader.

variants.parameter_guidance: Pass the existing target as subject_ref and optionally save_existing_map; no create or factory parameters are accepted.
variants.result_guidance: accepted means operation registration only. Preserve the original operation_ref and call operation.resume with the latest generation until typed latest_signal reports phase entered/ready; only then is the session usable. After the task, call operation.cancel, operation.resume to a safe boundary until terminal, read operation.receipt, then operation.release.
variants.summary: Open or switch the Editor to one existing target map; this variant does not create a map asset.
